summary: Billing turns customers' usage into invoices every weeknight, lets billing clerks look up customers and invoices and mark invoices as paid, and tells the payments system when an invoice is paid.

capabilities.name: Nightly invoicing
capabilities.description: Price the day's usage and write one invoice per customer.

domains.name: Collections
domains.description: Following invoices until they are paid.

capabilities.name: Look up customers and invoices
capabilities.description: Find a customer and see their open invoices.

capabilities.name: Record a payment
capabilities.description: Mark an invoice as paid and tell the payments system.

actors.name: Billing clerk
actors.description: Looks up invoices and records payments.

actors.name: Autosys
actors.description: Starts the nightly billing cycle on weekdays.

actors.name: Payments system
actors.description: Receives paid-invoice events and sends payments in.

actors.name: Billing operations
actors.description: Receive an e-mail when the invoice job fails.

use_cases.name: Record that an invoice is paid
use_cases.goal: Close an invoice the customer has paid
use_cases.outcome: The invoice is marked paid and the payments system is told.

business_rules.name: Only unbilled usage is invoiced
business_rules.description: Usage records already billed are skipped; amounts are units times rate, summed per customer.

data_entities.name: Invoice
data_entities.description: What a customer owes for a period.

data_entities.name: Usage record
data_entities.description: One metered use of the service, with units and rate.

screens.purpose: The clerk reads one invoice and can record its payment.
screens.next_steps: After paying, the invoice list opens.

batches.purpose: Bill every customer for yesterday's usage before the working day starts.
batches.when: Every weekday night at 01:30, once the usage file has arrived.

steps.description: Wait for the day's usage file from the network.
Price the usage and write one invoice per customer, then notify customers.
Archive the usage file, whether invoicing worked or not.

batches.on_failure: Autosys raises an alarm and retries the invoice job once; the launch script e-mails billing operations. The archive step still runs.
batches.business_impact: Customers are not invoiced that day and cash collection is delayed.

interfaces.purpose: Tells payments an invoice was paid.

glossary.meaning: Metered consumption of the service that is billed per unit.
